evidence_boundary: Model-level group experiment; no cited device is a fabricated v14M BDJ meeting every selected target simultaneously.

selected_device.name: Bimodal Diffusive Junction (BDJ)
selected_device.target_stack: Ag or Ag-alloy / ultrathin HfO2-class dielectric / Pt-class bottom electrode
selected_device.volatile_role: low-compliance weak filament integrates pulse history, fires, then self-relaxes
selected_device.nonvolatile_role: higher-stress stable filament stores OFF/WEAK/STRONG learned relation

learning_rewrite_screen_at_20pct_read_si.note: Device redundancy helps failed writes; semantically wrong feedback remains common-mode.

decision: KEEP at model level; physical promotion requires one fabricated stack to close volatile speed/energy plus reversible nonvolatile programming without per-device transistor compliance/selection.
